records.title: Second-Year Bulgarian
records.text: BULGR 404 Second-Year Bulgarian (5) A&H Continuation of BULGR 401, BULGR 402, BULGR 403. Selected readings in Bulgarian literature, history, and culture. Reinforces and extends basic knowledge of Bulgarian grammar and vocabulary. First in a sequence of three. Prerequisite: minimum grade of 2.0 in BULGR 403. Offered: A.
